$comment: 元件的維護期（支援期檢查 support_check.py 用）。每筆要有來源網址與查核日期（checked）；end 是 YYYY-MM，沒有公開資料時 null。查核日期超過 max_age_days 天時提醒重新查核。informational：只列出、不影響狀態（例如上游分支已停止，但實際維護由發行版或廠商負責）。families：SBOM 裡有這類元件、卻沒有任何（非 informational）項目對到時，結果是 NOT_ASSESSED 並寫出元件與版本。名稱 NVIDIA Jetson Linux 是刷機包掃描時 firmware_bom.py 加進產品 SBOM 的 L4T 元件。不放公司產品資料。

entries.name: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
entries.note: Ubuntu Pro phases build on each other: Legacy add-on requires Ubuntu Pro. Canonical's release-cycle page shows May 2034 (ESM) and May 2039 (Legacy); endoflife.date gives 2034-04-25 for ESM and has no Legacy date. April is used for both (one month earlier than Canonical's page for Legacy, a conservative choice without a separate source).
entries.coverage: Only packages from the Ubuntu main and restricted components, which Canonical maintains in the standard period. Packages from universe are maintained only with Ubuntu Pro (ESM-Apps); packages from other repositories (for example Docker, ROS or vendor apt repositories) are not maintained by Canonical and were not assessed here.

entries.name: Ubuntu 24.04 GA kernel 6.8 (linux-image generic/lowlatency, Canonical)
entries.note: Only the 24.04 GA kernel (versions without a '~' suffix; 22.04 HWE kernels such as 6.8.0-52.53~22.04.1 follow 22.04) and the generic/lowlatency flavours; other flavours (oem, aws, nvidia, nvidia-tegra) have their own lifecycle and are not in this table. ESM end: the earlier of Canonical's page (May 2034) and endoflife.date (2034-04-25) is used.

entries.name: NVIDIA Jetson Linux R39 (JetPack 7.2)
entries.note: NVIDIA has not published an end of maintenance for Jetson Linux R39 (release notes; the roadmap page is an image and was not checked). Precedent: maintenance of JetPack 4 and the corresponding Jetson Linux releases ended in November 2024.

entries.name: NVIDIA Jetson Linux R38 (JetPack 7.0, 7.1)
entries.note: NVIDIA has not published an end of maintenance for Jetson Linux R38 (release notes; the roadmap page is an image and was not checked).

entries.name: NVIDIA Jetson kernel 6.8 (nvidia-l4t-kernel)

phases.name: maintenance by NVIDIA as part of Jetson Linux

entries.note: Maintained by NVIDIA as part of Jetson Linux; no separate end date published. The upstream 6.8 stable branch has ended (see linux-6.8-upstream).

entries.name: Linux kernel 6.8 (upstream stable branch)
entries.note: 6.8 is not a longterm branch; 6.8.12 (2024-05-30) was the last upstream release. Security fixes after that depend on the kernel vendor (Canonical for Ubuntu kernels, NVIDIA for Jetson kernels).

entries.name: Debian 12 (bookworm)
entries.note: debian.org/releases/bookworm says full Debian support until 2026-07-11 (the date of the 12.15 point release); wiki.debian.org/LTS (updated 2026-08-31) gives the LTS period as 2026-06-11 to 2028-06-30. The earlier month (2026-06) is used for the regular phase. Debian LTS is free and uses the same archive; Extended LTS (2033-06-30 on debian.org/releases) is a commercial Freexian offering.
entries.coverage: Packages in the Debian main archive. LTS is limited to i386, amd64, armhf, arm64 and ppc64el (bookworm page); which packages stay supported during LTS was not assessed. Packages from other repositories (for example a board vendor's apt repository) are not maintained by Debian.

entries.name: Debian 13 (trixie)
entries.note: debian.org/releases/trixie: full Debian support until 2028-08-09, then LTS until 2030-06-30; wiki.debian.org/LTS lists the same LTS period. Extended LTS until 2035-06-30 (debian.org/releases) is a commercial Freexian offering.
entries.coverage: Packages in the Debian main archive. The LTS architecture list for trixie is 'to be determined' on wiki.debian.org/LTS; which packages stay supported during LTS was not assessed. Raspberry Pi OS and board vendor images also use this entry for their Debian packages, but packages from the Raspberry Pi or board vendor repositories are not maintained by Debian (see their own entries).

entries.name: Debian 13 kernel 6.12
entries.note: The kernel package of Debian 13 is maintained by Debian as part of the release, so it follows the Debian 13 phases. Checked against the generic amd64 cloud image 20261111 (linux-image-6.12.116+deb13-amd64 6.12.116-1). Whether Debian keeps 6.12 for the whole LTS period was not assessed.

entries.name: Linux 6.12 (upstream longterm)
entries.note: kernel.org longterm table: 6.12, projected EOL Dec 2028. Projected dates can change; the distribution or vendor maintenance is the relevant one.

entries.name: Raspberry Pi kernel 6.18
entries.note: Raspberry Pi does not publish a maintenance period for its kernel packages or for Raspberry Pi OS (the operating systems page only says the Legacy image is 'a port of Debian Bookworm with security updates'). Checked against Raspberry Pi OS Lite 2026-10-06 (linux-image-6.18.50+rpt-rpi-2712 and -rpi-v8, 1:6.18.50-1+rpt1).

entries.name: Linux 6.18 (upstream longterm)
entries.note: kernel.org longterm table: 6.18, projected EOL Dec 2028.

entries.name: Raspberry Pi boot firmware (raspi-firmware)
entries.note: Closed-source VideoCore boot firmware from the Raspberry Pi apt repository; no published maintenance period.

entries.name: Radxa Rockchip BSP kernel 6.1 (rk2410)
entries.note: Rockchip BSP kernel (branch linux-6.1-stan-rkr4.1) built and packaged by Radxa. The Radxa software support matrix lists image versions only ('updated with the image release cycle'); no maintenance period or security update policy is published. Checked against ROCK 5B rsdk-r6 (linux-image-6.1.84-8-rk2410 6.1.84-8).

entries.name: Linux 6.1 (upstream longterm)
entries.note: kernel.org longterm table: 6.1, projected EOL Dec 2027. A vendor BSP kernel based on 6.1 does not automatically receive these fixes.

entries.name: Radxa U-Boot 2017.09 (u-boot-rk2410)
entries.note: Rockchip vendor U-Boot 2017.09 with closed rkbin binaries (DDR init, TF-A BL31); no published maintenance period.

entries.name: openmediavault 8 (Synchrony)
entries.note: The release table lists 8.0 Synchrony (Debian 13, Dec 2025) as 'Stable' without an end date; 7.0 Sandworm (Debian 12) is listed as 'EOL - Jun 2026'. That suggests OMV follows its Debian base, but no date is published for 8, so none is assumed.
